releases.notes:
## New: death marker

After you die, a skull on the locator bar (the bar above the hotbar that shows other players) points to the exact spot where you died, so you can walk back and pick up your items.

![Skull on the locator bar and death reminders in chat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vittoriopippi/papou_mc/v1.3.0/docs/screenshots/death-marker.png)

- Right after you respawn, the chat shows the coordinates and dimension where you died.
- Every minute, a reminder in chat says how far away the spot is and how many minutes are left.
- After 5 minutes (the time dropped items take to despawn) the skull disappears with a last message. The timer follows game time, so pausing in singleplayer pauses it too.
- The skull only shows in the dimension where you died; elsewhere the reminders say which dimension it was in.
- Dying again moves the marker and restarts the 5 minutes.

It works entirely on your side, so it works on any server and with Essential. To turn it off, set `"deathMarkerEnabled": false` in `config/papou.json`.

## Installing

If you have 1.1.0 or later, the update popup at startup installs this version for you. Otherwise, replace the old `papouhud-*.jar` in your `mods` folder with `papouhud-1.3.0.jar`.

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 and Fabric API.

releases.notes:
## What's new
- **Furnace XP:** furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces now show how much XP they're holding (e.g. `15.4 XP`) on the title row, aligned to the right. Hover over it for a short explanation. Nothing is shown while the furnace holds no XP.

![Furnace showing 15.4 XP on the title row](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vittoriopippi/papou_mc/main/docs/screenshots/furnace-xp.png)

## Who needs the mod
Stored XP only exists on the server side of the game, so whoever runs the world must have Papou HUD 1.2.0:
- **Singleplayer:** works out of the box.
- **Essential / Open to LAN:** the **host** needs it. Friends who join also need it to see the number.
- **Dedicated server:** add the jar to the server's `mods` folder too.

On a server without the mod, the XP line simply doesn't appear and everything else works as before.

## Updating
If you have 1.1.0, the update popup at startup will offer this version: click **Update** and restart the game. From 1.0.0, replace the jar in `.minecraft/mods` by hand.

## Requirements
Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 · Fabric API · Java 25

releases.notes:
## What's new
- **Update check:** at startup Papou HUD checks for a newer release. If there is one, a single popup on the main menu offers to update. **Update** downloads the new version, which is installed automatically when you close the game. **Not now** asks again next launch.
- To turn it off, set `"checkForUpdates": false` in `config/papou.json`.
- Fixed the mod description: the friend panels are in the top-left corner.

![Update popup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vittoriopippi/papou_mc/main/docs/screenshots/update-popup.png)

## Upgrading from 1.0.0
1.0.0 has no update check, so do this one by hand: remove `papouhud-1.0.0.jar` from `.minecraft/mods` and add `papouhud-1.1.0.jar`. Later versions will offer to install themselves.

## Requirements
Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 · Fabric API · Java 25

releases.notes:
First release of Papou HUD, a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2.

## Features
- **Friend panels** (top-left): name, worn armor with durability bars, armor points and hearts for every nearby player.
- **Compass** (top-center): directions with north in red and the current heading in degrees.
- **XYZ coordinates** under the compass.
- **Settings menu** to show/hide each element and rebind shortcuts.
- English and Italian translations.

## Default keys
`H` friend panels · `N` compass · `J` coordinates · `M` settings menu

## Requirements
Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 · Fabric API · Java 25

## Install
Drop `papouhud-1.0.0.jar` and Fabric API into `.minecraft/mods`.
